dialogue.pool.family.offer.15: Is ৳{offer} fine with you bhai? We'll step off right at the apartment driveway.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.01: Could you do ৳{counter}? We'll tip for the safe ride.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.02: ৳{counter} and please don't rush with the kid.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.03: ৳{fare} is a bit heavy on a family man's monthly expenses, bhai—make it ৳{counter}?
dialogue.pool.family.counter.04: Brother, let's settle at ৳{counter} and please come ten steps closer so Ma doesn't walk.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.05: I'll raise our offer to ৳{counter} if you promise zero sudden lane weaving.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.06: Have respect for elders, brother—৳{counter} is very reasonable for this trip.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.07: If we pay ৳{counter}, can you wait thirty seconds while we secure the luggage bag?
dialogue.pool.family.counter.08: Let's meet in the middle at ৳{counter}, bhai. Household budgets are tight these days.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.09: Brother, ৳{counter} cash in hand, and you don't need to race any buses for us.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.10: Make it ৳{counter} bhai, my child is getting tired standing in the sun.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.11: We can stretch to ৳{counter} at most, brother. Keep both our families happy!
dialogue.pool.family.counter.12: Take ৳{counter} brother, and drop us on the quiet side of the street.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.13: Bhai, ৳{counter} is fair when we're not asking you to hurry through traffic.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.14: Let's close at ৳{counter}, brother. We'll call you again for our weekend visits.
dialogue.pool.family.counter.15: Final family offer: ৳{counter}, with full five stars for a gentle, bump-free ride!
dialogue.pool.family.accept.01: Thank you, ৳{offer} is good. Please be careful.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.03: Agreed at ৳{fare}, brother! Hold the bike steady while my mother sits down.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.04: Bless you bhai! I've placed the shopping bag in the middle—let's go gently.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.05: Deal! Please slow down well before every speed breaker on the road.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.06: Thank you for understanding a family's needs. We're seated and ready!
dialogue.pool.family.accept.07: Accepted brother! Take the wider main avenue even if it takes two extra minutes.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.08: Fine with us, bhai. Let's fasten the helmet strap properly first.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.09: Wonderful! Please keep a safe distance from those big city buses.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.10: Settled at ৳{offer}. Take off smoothly so the little one doesn't jolt backward.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.11: Okay brother, everything is secure. You can roll out slowly now.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.12: Thank you for coming right to the gate! Let's head out in Allah's name.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.13: Agreed! No rush at all, brother—reaching safely is our only priority.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.14: Done deal bhai! Watch out for the wet drain cover near the corner.
dialogue.pool.family.accept.15: Great, we're ready! Keep the ride steady and peaceful all the way.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.01: That's not safe with luggage and a child. We'll wait.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.02: Too expensive for us, sorry brother.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.03: No brother, at that price we might as well hire a full CNG for the family.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.04: We can't walk that far with bags and an elder! We'll wait for another ride.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.05: Sorry bhai, our monthly household budget doesn't allow such a high fare.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.06: You look like you're in too much of a hurry for a family passenger. Pass!
dialogue.pool.family.reject.07: No deal brother, I need to save money for my child's school tiffin and books.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.08: That fare is way above the neighborhood standard. Have a safe trip ahead!
dialogue.pool.family.reject.09: We'll take a cycle rickshaw through the residential lane instead. Thank you.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.10: Cannot agree to that, bhai. My mother can't climb on from the busy middle lane.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.11: Too steep for a short family errand. Assalamu Alaikum brother.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.12: Sorry brother, without a clean passenger helmet we can't risk the main road.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.13: We'll wait for our neighborhood regular rider instead. Good day!
dialogue.pool.family.reject.14: No thanks bhai, that quote would eat up our entire bazaar allowance.
dialogue.pool.family.reject.15: Declining brother—family safety and fair budget both matter to us.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.01: The kids are so noisy in the morning, brother.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.02: My mother used to ride like this in her youth, you know.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.03: Does your mother also call you three times a day to ask if you ate lunch?
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.04: My daughter's scholarship exam is next week—the whole house is studying with her!
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.05: In this traffic jam, keeping a child entertained without a cartoon on the phone is impossible.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.06: When it rains on Friday, my wife insists on cooking khichuri and hilsa for everyone.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.07: Our whole family sat together with muri-chanachur to watch the cricket match yesterday!
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.08: Thank you for slowing down at that pothole—the sweet boxes stayed completely intact.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.09: Buying vegetables and fish for a joint family takes two full bags every weekend.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.10: My father always says a rider's character shows in how he treats pedestrians and elders.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.11: Look at those school kids sharing one umbrella in the drizzle—reminds me of childhood.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.12: Living in Dhaka is expensive, but when the family eats together at night, all stress fades.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.13: You ride with the care of someone who has elders waiting at home too, brother.
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.14: If our cricket team wins the trophy, my son wants a new bat as his exam reward!
dialogue.pool.family.small_talk.15: Please pull over near the shaded side of the gate so my mother can step down easily.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.01: Thank you for the careful ride, everyone is safe.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.02: Please rate us well, we're grateful to you.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.03: Wait two seconds while I lift the bags off first—here is your ৳{fare}, brother!
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.04: Not a single harsh brake the entire trip! My mother is giving you her blessings.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.05: Here is ৳{fare} plus extra for tea, bhai. You took care of my family like your own.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.06: Stopped right by the flat entrance—zero walking needed! Five stars for you brother.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.07: The glass jars and sweets arrived without a scratch. Thank you for your steady hands!
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.08: Paid ৳{fare} in cash. Make sure you call your mother and eat on time today, bhai!
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.09: My little nephew enjoyed the ride so much he didn't cry once. Bless you brother!
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.10: Here's the helmet back. May Allah protect you on every road you travel.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.11: Gentle acceleration, safe turns, and polite behavior—you're a model rider in Dhaka!
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.12: Here is your full ৳{fare}, brother. We'll definitely book you again for family trips.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.13: Thank you for waiting patiently while my elder stepped down safely.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.14: All settled brother! Go home safely to your own family after your shift.
dialogue.pool.family.drop_off.15: Exact ৳{fare} handed over with our warmest thanks. Ride safe, brother!
dialogue.char.tanvir.punctual: My boss actually commended me on punctuality after that swift ride you gave me!
dialogue.char.tanvir.rush_meeting: Rafi! Always a relief when I see your bike when my schedule is on fire.
dialogue.char.tanvir.bonus: Here's the bonus I promised. Corporate riders never forget those who help in a crunch.
dialogue.char.mintu.tea_discount: Rafi dost! Come by the stall tonight, hot malai cha is on the house for you.
dialogue.char.mintu.bike_sound: Your bike's engine sounds much healthier today. Kamal bhai did a solid tuning job!
dialogue.char.mintu.drop: Keep the fare, or rather, I'll deduct it from your monthly tea tab at the stall, haha!
dialogue.char.rahim.shortcut: See? The elders know cuts through Puran Dhaka that your satellite maps never dreamed of!
dialogue.char.rahim.respect: Bite-sized Rafi! You drive with the patience of an old soul. Take this uncle to the mosque.
dialogue.char.rahim.blessing: May Allah fill your journey with safety and barakah. Take these sweets for your mother.
dialogue.char.ferdousi.safe_child: My little boy wasn't scared at all on your bike. You drove like a true caring elder brother.
dialogue.char.ferdousi.school_run: Rafi brother, school exam starts soon. I trust only you to take us there without panic.
dialogue.char.ferdousi.gratitude: A mother's prayers will always accompany your motorcycle, brother. Take care.
dialogue.char.kamal.mechanic_review: That upgraded motorcycle suits your riding style nicely. Keep the engine oil fresh every 1000 km!
dialogue.char.kamal.garage_call: Rafi! Hop over to the spare parts depot with me, I have heavy brake shoes to fetch.
dialogue.char.kamal.discount_hint: Whenever your bike feels loose, bring it straight to my bay. Family rates always apply.
dialogue.char.nabila.exam_passed: I aced that semester final! Thanks for giving students a break on fares back then.
dialogue.char.nabila.campus: Rafi bhai! Going to the university library. Settle a decent student rate today?
dialogue.char.jamil.silent: You have rigid principles on these streets, rider. Some admire it, others find it troublesome.
dialogue.char.jamil.cooperation: Well well, our reliable partner! The night is lucrative when everyone understands their role.
dialogue.char.morshed.helmet_praise: If all riders in Dhaka strapped on certified helmets like you do, our trauma wards would be half empty.
dialogue.char.morshed.duty: Rafi, quick drop to the traffic control room. Law abiding citizens always get my respect.
dialogue.char.bablu.heavy_haul: That luggage carrier upgrade turned your bike into a true market workhorse, brother!
dialogue.char.bablu.market_rush: Rafi mama! Fresh vegetable crates just arrived from Savar. Help me haul a quick bundle!
